notes.title: My Beastly Lovers will be removed from the store
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are sorry to inform you that My Beastly Lovers will be removed from the Steam store. 

You should be able to keep on playing the copy you have bought before the removal of the game. 

Thank you for these few years!

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.34
notes.notes:
My Beastly Lovers v0.34 has the following changes:
[list]
    [*]A tiny delay was added to each conversation line so you cannot accidentally skip a whole line by pressing E, left-click or equivalent controller button and miss something important by doing so.
    [*]The Flirt button is disabled while player has not yet discussed about the subject with the lover candidate. Flirt button will be active after the subject has been talked about.
    [*]The extra button was removed from the conversations with lover candidates. These conversations only include buttons "Talk", "Flirt", "Gift", "Quest" and "Bye" from now on.
    [*]Sound effects were added to correct and wrong answers in flirting.
[/list] 
Let us know what do you think about these changes and if there is anything else you'd like to fix or change!

notes.title: MBL just released!
notes.notes:
We are happy to inform that My Beastly Lovers is now officially published in Steam! 

The Valentine's day is right behind the corner and if you don't have a date planned, no worries! You can turn to the single monsters of Ferrus when in need of love and affection! No need to spend the most romantic day of the year alone!
